sheets.title: Settings › Capabilities › AI, WebMCP tools switched on mid-session — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: WebMCP registers this page's tools with the browser, which has to happen in a fresh document (requiresDocumentReload). A guest turns it on after the page has already run other modules. Before, the switch said on and nothing else: the tile claimed a capability that had not started and could not start in place. After, the plan keeps it approved with RELOAD_REQUIRED, the loader refuses to start it before any import, and the tile wears a warn mark whose label is reload to start. The switch still says on, because it is on.
sheets.before: switch on; status marks on the tile: 0
sheets.after: switch on; status marks: 1, labelled “reload to start”
